## README.md
# USGS National Hydrography Dataset (NHD) — Streams (national)

Cloud-native distribution of the **USGS National Hydrography Dataset, High Resolution** stream network (`NHDFlowline`), nationwide (50 states + DC + PR/VI + Pacific territories as bundled in the USGS national seamless GDB). Two layers:

| Dataset | What it is | Features |
|---|---|---|
| **`streams-by-order`** | All NHD flowlines, with **Strahler stream order** attached from the NHDPlus value-added attribute table (`NHDFlowlineVAA`). | ~30.2 M lines |
| **`perennial-streams`** | NHD flowlines filtered to **perennial** streams/rivers (`FCODE = 46006`). | subset of the above |

- **Producer:** U.S. Geological Survey, National Hydrography Program (High Resolution).
- **License:** `public-domain` (US federal work).
- **Source:** `NHD_H_National_GDB.zip` (national seamless High-Resolution GDB).
- **Geometry:** vector lines (`MultiLineString`), **OGC:CRS84** (lon, lat). Reprojected from the source NAD83 (EPSG:4269).
- **H3 hex:** each dataset is indexed to **H3 resolution 8**. Line features are hexed to H3 res 8 by **buffering each segment by the H3 cell circumradius before polyfill**.

Each dataset ships three assets: GeoParquet (`<name>.parquet`), PMTiles (`<name>.pmtiles`), and hive-partitioned H3 hex (`<name>/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet`).

---

## DuckDB — query the GeoParquet

```sql
INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;

-- Perennial streams in a bounding box (lon/lat). The geometry column is SHAPE.
SELECT permanent_identifier, gnis_name, lengthkm, fcode
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-usgs-nhd/perennial-streams.parquet')
WHERE ST_Intersects(SHAPE, ST_MakeEnvelope(-122.6, 37.7, -122.3, 37.9))
LIMIT 20;

-- Stream-order distribution (streams-by-order)
SELECT streamorder, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-usgs-nhd/streams-by-order.parquet')
GROUP BY streamorder ORDER BY streamorder;
```

## DuckDB — H3 hex (aggregation / spatial join)

```sql
-- How many res-8 cells does the perennial network touch in each h0 region?
SELECT h0, COUNT(DISTINCT h8) AS cells
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-usgs-nhd/perennial-streams/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet')
GROUP BY h0 ORDER BY cells DESC;
```

> **Hex aggregation caveat.** One hex row = one (flowline, h8) pair. Per-feature columns
> (`lengthkm`, `shape_length`) are **repeated on every cell a flowline covers** — never `SUM`
> them on hex data. Network length ≈ `SUM(lengthkm)` only after `SELECT DISTINCT permanent_identifier, lengthkm`.
> The H3 index columns (`h8`, `h0`) are the only fields safe to aggregate directly.

## MapLibre GL JS — PMTiles

The `source-layer` is the **last segment of the dataset name** (`streams-by-order` or `perennial-streams`), NOT the GDB layer name.

```js
const map = new maplibregl.Map({
  container: 'map',
  style: 'https://demotiles.maplibre.org/style.json',
  center: [-119, 37], zoom: 5
});
map.on('load', () => {
  const p = new pmtiles.PMTiles('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-usgs-nhd/perennial-streams.pmtiles');
  protocol.add(p);
  map.addSource('streams', { type: 'vector', url: 'pmtiles://' + p.source.getKey() });
  map.addLayer({
    id: 'streams', type: 'line', source: 'streams',
    'source-layer': 'perennial-streams',
    paint: { 'line-color': '#2b8cbe', 'line-width': 0.6 }
  });
});
```

---

## Stream order

`streams-by-order` carries `streamorder` (Strahler stream order, integer) joined from the NHD
value-added attribute table `NHDFlowlineVAA` on `permanent_identifier`. Higher = larger
downstream river; headwater channels are order 1. `streamlevel` (downstream-mainstem level) is
included as well. Flowlines with no VAA match have NULL stream order.

## FCODE (feature code) reference

`perennial-streams` is the subset where `fcode = 46006`. For reference, related stream FCODEs in the source:

| FCODE | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 46000 | Stream/River (general, unspecified hydrographic category) |
| 46003 | Stream/River — Intermittent |
| **46006** | **Stream/River — Perennial** |
| 46007 | Stream/River — Ephemeral |
| 46100 | Submerged Stream |

Source: USGS NHD `NHDFCode` domain table.
